identity.name: Inventory Sorter CSR Compatibility
aliases: Inventory Sorter × Container Slot Reservations Compatibility

goals: Make CSR-reserved physical slots immutable to Inventory Sorter while preserving its normal order and stack behavior for all movable slots.
Treat occupied vanilla bundles and every vanilla shulker-box item as fixed sort obstacles without inspecting or mutating their contents or components.
Apply the same mask to Inventory Sorter's authoritative server sort, client fallback click plan, and player bundle-insertion route.
scope: Canary 1 intercepts only Inventory Sorter 3.0.0's ContainerInventorySorter whole-range layout/writeback seam and ClientFallbackSortPlanBuilder fallback-click seam.

CSR detection calls ContainerSlotReservationsApi.isReserved on the exact Slot container and Slot#getContainerSlot local index; CSR resolves supported physical owners, including double-container mappings.
A masked range compacts only movable slots through Inventory Sorter's own SortedInventoryLayout, writes or clicks only their original physical/menu slots, and never uses fixed slots as workspace.
When a fixed slot exists, the incompatible optional bundle-target insertion pass is bypassed because it would inspect or mutate a bundle; ordinary no-fixed-slot behavior remains fully upstream.
The player's special upstream sort-into-bundles branch is replaced only when it contains a bundle or shulker, using the ordinary masked player sort instead.

exclusions: Does not modify, bundle, redistribute, or copy source/resources from Inventory Sorter or Container Slot Reservations.
Does not change CSR reservation data, insertion admission, hopper, QUICK_MOVE, QSN, CCAR, manual interaction, comparator rules, or supported-owner policy.
Does not intercept broad vanilla inventory APIs; it acts only inside audited Inventory Sorter sort entrypoints.
Exact Inventory Sorter and CSR JAR versions are controlled-validation and bytecode-contract baselines, not exact runtime dependency pins.
